blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla challenged former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and his wife to return to the Philippines and take a polygraph test amid allegations linking them to alleged cash deliveries to the Duterte family. “The lie detector test is not admissible in court. But I’m asking the Velasco couple to come home and take the same test. We’ll see who’s telling the truth,” said the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) chief at an ambush interview after an event at Pasay City on Thursday.
